messages:
Lynne: Heads-up I opened a new docs PR for a Windows offline installer walkthrough with KMS/HSM integration examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4891. Includes HTTPS artifact mirror example, PowerShell snippets, PKCS#11 vendor hints, and a short migration checklist.

Omar: Nice. Quick Q: should we recommend HTTPS mirrors as the default for air-gapped Windows hosts? SMB can be flaky across versions.

Lynne: I intended to show both. Current PR has SMB appendix but I just pushed an HTTPS example using Invoke-WebRequest. Noting perf tradeoffs and when to prefer SMB (LANs with high throughput).

Sanjay: Security items to include: signed drivers requirement for Windows HSMs, steps to restrict the installer service account, and registry keys to enforce driver signing. Also call out PS script to set GPO exceptions where required.

Rachel: CI smoke failed on the windows-smoke runner against the branch. Snippet from the log: ```
2026-02-15T09:14:02Z ERROR installer: failed to map network drive \\10.1.3.10\artifacts
System.UnauthorizedAccessException: Access denied
```
Looks like credential handling for SMB sample needs clearer instructions.

Lynne: I added explicit steps for creating a narrow service account with read-only perms on the SMB share and an example net use command with /user flag. Also added checksum verification example: ```powershell
$h=Get-FileHash .\\redwood-installer.zip -Algorithm SHA256; if ($h.Hash -ne 'REPLACE_WITH_SHA256') { throw 'checksum mismatch' }
```

Omar: Add note to prefer TLS-enabled HTTPS mirror on WAN links and show how to configure curl/Invoke-WebRequest with client certs if customers use mTLS.

Lynne: Added mTLS snippet and a one-liner for cert thumbprint pinning in PowerShell.

Sanjay: For the HSM appendix: please add common PKCS11 module paths for YubiHSM2, Thales Luna, and SafeNet on Windows (even rough locations). Also call out the Vendor-supplied middleware installer order: vendor driver -> middleware -> Redwood agent.

Lynne: Added a small table mapping vendor -> example DLL path and a note about installing vendor middleware before starting the Redwood service.

docs-bot: link-checker/4891 started. Found 2 issues: one relative anchor in docs/hsm/windows.md#pkcs11-examples (suggest rename to pkcs11-windows) and a broken link to /guides/migration that should point to /guides/migrate-from-linux.

Lynne: Fixed the anchor and updated the migration link. Pushed. Can folks do a quick review? I want this merged before tomorrow's release cut.

Rachel: I'll re-run the windows-smoke job after the SMB -> HTTPS changes. If green, approve.

Omar: LGTM for infra bits. Tiny wording nit: replace "open firewall ports" with "allow egress to mirror host on port 443/445 as required".

Sanjay: LGTM once we have the driver signing/registry note and the vendor DLL examples. Approve pending that.

Lynne: Thanks all. I'll add a short 'migration-from-linux-quickstart' checklist in a follow-up PR: steps will be export KMS keys (export procedure link), install vendor drivers, map PKCS11 to agent, and run the windows-smoke verification. Tagging you all on the follow-up.
